lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible as three primary horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters posterior to the gill slits. The central row exhibits the highest contrast and most regular spacing of local maxima.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal spot rows to create a grid-like distribution where spots are situated within the lighter vertical zones.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with highlight on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of diffuse, high-luminance blobs is visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated along the anterior margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of six distinct, high-luminance, elongated cylindrical structures attached to the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin. The fin margin exhibits irregular serrations at these attachment points.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a significantly higher spatial frequency and denser distribution of smaller high-luminance spots compared to the more sparse grid pattern on the lateral flank.
